d.d: A syllable used in solfège to represent the sixth note of a major scale.
Sometimes syllable for both the third and the sixth.
Represents the sound of music or singing.
d.x: "La la la la, I can't hear you!" Jimmy said, sticking his fingers in his ears.

d.d: Prefixed to the name of a woman, with ironic effect (as though an opera prima donna).
